items.title: Exactness of the inverse image on abelian sheaves and of the pullback along a flat morphism of ringed topoi
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves two exactness statements: the inverse image functor on abelian sheaves along any morphism of ringed topoi is exact, and the pullback on modules is exact when the morphism of ringed topoi is flat. The first part uses that the underlying sheaf of sets of the inverse image of an abelian sheaf is the inverse image of the underlying sheaf of sets, so that exactness of the set-theoretic inverse image required in the definition of a morphism of topoi gives exactness on abelian sheaves (proof lines 5779-5788). The second part recalls the definition of the pullback of modules in terms of the structure map and reduces exactness to flatness of the structure map (proof lines 5789-5794). H2: the reduction of the first statement to the definition of a morphism of topoi, and of the second to the definition of flatness, are the substance.
